content: FastMCP 3.x (this repo pins fastmcp-slim 3.4.7 via fastmcp>=2.0): @mcp.tool(...) returns a FunctionTool/Tool OBJECT, not the original callable -- this only changes in FastMCP 4.0 ('Decorators now return the original function unchanged'). FastMCP's own tag-based visibility API (mcp.disable(names=...)/mcp.disable(tags=...)/mcp.enable(tags=..., only=True)) operates AFTER a Tool object already exists; a tool that is never handed to mcp.tool() at all (this repo's actual gating pattern -- return the bare function when the tier check fails) never becomes a Tool object and so never appears in any registry built by iterating Tool.meta on registered tools.
